instruction: csv_parser.parse_line() splits a CSV record on every delimiter and strips all double quotes, so quoted fields such as "Smith, John" or "say ""hi""" come out wrong. Fix parse_line(line, delimiter=',') so that: fields wrapped in double quotes may contain the delimiter; inside a quoted field a doubled quote ("") means one literal quote; quotes in the middle of an unquoted field are kept literally; whitespace is preserved; a trailing \n or \r\n is ignored; an unterminated quoted field raises ValueError. parse(text) must keep returning one list per non-blank line. Do not use the csv module.
